item.title: India, Canada finalise national work plan on security, law enforcement
item.description: India and Canada have agreed on a national work plan to strengthen security, law enforcement, cybersecurity cooperation and information sharing

item.title: Bengaluru Metro defers fare hike amid political row
item.description: The 5 per cent annual revision, to take effect on February 9, has been put on hold after commuter backlash, political sparring between Congress, BJP, and JD(S)

item.title: Cheap US imports will help dairy sector, but hit Indian soybean farmers
item.description: Former Shetkari Sanghatana leader says imported Dried Distillers Grains with Solubles will harm farmers, as de-oiled cake has been propping up soyabean price

item.title: A decade after the 2016 event which saw JNU being branded ‘anti-national’, what's changed on campus
item.description: On Feb 9, 2016, an event at JNU, organised on the anniversary of Afzal Guru’s execution, saw Delhi Police arresting three students on sedition charges. A decade later, the university, once known for open debate and political ferment, is marked by a ‘sense of intimidation’ and ‘trust deficit’.

item.title: Tobacco baron’s son driving Lamborghini hits pedestrians in Kanpur, six injured
item.description: At least six people were injured after a speeding Lamborghini allegedly driven by a businessman’s son rammed pedestrians and vehicles on Kanpur’s VIP Road

item.title: India, Malaysia deepen economic ties with focus on semiconductors, energy, digital sector
item.description: Joint statement during Modi’s Malaysia visit outlines cooperation on trade facilitation, semiconductors, renewable energy and digital payments

item.title: Centre denies political clearance to Punjab CM's foreign trip for the third time
item.description: Centre denies political clearance for Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann’s foreign trip again, forcing cancellation of proposed Czech Republic and Netherlands visit.

item.title: Bomb threat emails sent to 10 Delhi schools, security checks underway
item.description: Schools were evacuated as a precaution after emails warned of explosions; police say no suspicious objects have been found so far

item.title: 'Will not be intimidated by US threats,' says Iran amid rising tension
item.description: Iran’s foreign minister says Tehran will not yield to US pressure or abandon enrichment, voicing distrust of the Trump administration amid rising military tensions.

item.title: Cong says ‘wait for action’ amid reports of no-trust motion against Lok Sabha Speaker
item.description: Amid reports of a possible no-confidence motion against Speaker Om Birla, Congress leaders allege opposition voices, including Rahul Gandhi’s, are being silenced in Parliament
